inputs.checklistItemText: Driveways do not maintain minimum 16-foot vertical clearance (parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot vertical clearance (areas with truck traffic) from lowest point of overhead electric facilities including telecommunications attachments
inputs.question: Are section or profile views provided showing vertical clearances from finished driveway grade elevations to overhead electric facility elevations? If yes, what are the specific vertical clearance dimensions shown?
inputs.regionHint: driveways and grading plan showing finished grade elevations

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether section/profile views exist and requesting label readout of dimensions shown on those views. This is a document-presence and label-readout question, not a measurement task. The actual clearance verification (comparing shown dimensions against 16-foot or 18-foot minimums) would come later; this step is discovering whether the necessary views and their annotated dimensions are present on the plans.
